title: Learning Reward and Policy Jointly from Demonstration and Preference Improves Alignment
reasoning: The paper focuses on a technical algorithmic framework for AI alignment, specifically integrating supervised fine-tuning and reward modeling. While alignment aims at making models 'helpful and harmless', which has ethical underpinnings, the paper's core contribution is mathematical and methodological. It does not specifically evaluate or benchmark religion, theology, or specific ethical or moral reasoning frameworks.
